  • Customer Name
  • Mobile Number
  • Group Name
  • Status (Active/Inactive)

title: Export Selected Product Log

Path.description: Export log table ID that contains selected product IDs.

description:
This API exports detailed Excel sheets for specific products recorded in the export log table. The Excel file includes:

  • Main product details
  • Special price list
  • Discount price list
  • Product images
  • Related categories

Each section is generated based on the product IDs stored in the export log entry.
